text:
THE CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE THE FOLLOWING SERVICES IN SUPPORT OF THE S3I DIRECTORATE: 
3.1.	SUPPORT THE ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY BRANCH WITH DEVELOPING, MANAGING, SUSTAINING AND UPGRADING THE SIMULATION AND STIMULATION INFRASTRUCTURE NEEDED TO TEST AND VERIFY PERFORMANCE OF COMPLEX MISSILE COMMAND /CONTROL, COMMUNICATIONS AND INSTRUMENTATION SUITES THAT WILL BE USED IN SUPPORT OF THE RTS RANGE FOR INTEGRATING AND TESTING OF MISSILES. THIS WORK SHALL INCLUDE:
3.1.1.	PROCURE THE HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE TO RE-HOST, DEVELOP, INTEGRATE AND TEST AN UPGRADED RANGE AUTOMATION AND DECISION SUPPORT (RADS) AND TELEMETRY OPEN SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE (TOSA) SOFTWARE PACKAGE/SYSTEM. PERFORM VERIFICATION TESTING ON THE RADS AND TOSA INTEGRATED INTO THE UPDATED HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE.  (IAW PWS PARA. 2.1.4, 2.2.4) 
3.1.2.	CONDUCT TESTING OF MISSILE SIMULATIONS TO VERIFY SOFTWARE EXECUTION AND KEY ALGORITHMS VERSUS THE ASSOCIATED SOFTWARE LIBRARIES ON THE UPGRADED SYSTEMS.  (IWA PWS PARA 2.1.3)
